# FLX-3515: a registry subject cannot carry the stream

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A stream whose contract names a registry subject is written against that subject, and the sink never registers a schema under it. That needs --sink-opt registry=URL, an Avro or JSON subject (a Protobuf subject and a Glue registry are not supported in this version), a column for every field of the subject, a field for every column, a value each field's type holds exactly (a decimal within its precision and scale, an Avro int or long within its range), and a derived &lt;topic&gt;-value subject that no contract binding names. The message names the subject, the field or the column, never a value. Name the registry, change the contract's subject or its columns to agree, or write the stream without a registry subject. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3515
```
